data.headline: Chief Technology Officer | Expert in Leading Digital Transformation & Innovation
data.about:
Visionary Chief Technology Officer with 12+ years of experience driving digital transformation and generating explosive growth through a practiced, systematic approach to technology management. 

Engaging communicator able to develop high-performance teams, build and maintain enduring partnerships with clients, colleagues and external partners, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership.

Seasoned strategic planner able to identify and analyze the forces that impact an organization’s ability to operate successfully and respond with proactive, efficient technology and development strategies. 

Growth-oriented expert in managing the day-to-day operation of governance, innovation, security, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, operations, infrastructure, applications and data and user support functions. 

Core Competencies: 

•	Enterprise Technology
•	Strategic Planning
•	Software Development
•	Risk Assessment	
•	Cloud Strategy
•	Information Security
•	Project Management 
•	Disaster Recovery Planning	
•	Budget Management
•	Expense Management
•	Cross-functional Collaboration
•	Analytical Thinking

experiences.title: Vice President of Technology and Development
experiences.subtitle: Youth Enrichment Brands . Full-time
experiences.caption: Jul 2023 - Jul 2024 · 1 yr

description.text:
•	Spearheaded the establishment of an integrated Information Technology and Software Development departments across all subsidiary companies, building and managing a diverse team of software developers, IT specialists, project managers, and business intelligence professionals.
•	Orchestrated the consolidation of disparate business unit data sources into a centralized Snowflake data warehouse, empowering seamless business intelligence operations.
•	Architected a robust system specifically tailored for direct-to-consumer retail sales, seamlessly accepting retail transactions, and efficiently delivering data to multiple fulfillment partners.
•	Led the development and management of multiple customized point-of-sale and billing systems at i9 Sports and US Sports Camps. These solutions were tailored to meet the unique needs of each organization, optimizing transaction processing, revenue tracking, and financial operations.
•	Successfully consolidated vendor relationships across all business subsidiaries, resulting in annual cost savings of approximately $100k.

•	Define and execute a system-wide technology strategy to drive revenue and market growth, through acquisitions and migrations to company system enabled by sound technology strategy, managing a budget of ~$1.7M. 
•	Direct the development of a large-scale registration, scheduling and automated billing application.
•	Create and direct the implementation of a secure and redundant cloud strategy, leveraging Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services.
•	Establish and manage the execution of a 24-month rolling software development roadmap, reducing costs in key verticals.
•	Negotiate major contracts, resulting in annual savings of over $400K.
•	Mentor the technology support, software support, information security and software development teams for ongoing performance improvement. 
•	Present bi-monthly to the Board of Directors on strategic direction.
•	Reduce labor expenditure by 2.5% within 12 months through automation, with a roadmap designed to further reduce labor by 8% over a three-year period.
•	Created and enforced IT backup strategy for the entire organization, comprised of both onsite and cloud-based requirements. 
•	Developed and enforced risk and change management policies for the organization, hosting annual reviews of risk posture and documenting as needed. 
•	Spearheaded efforts to improve the feature implementation and issue resolution process for a proprietary software platform that previously required hours per day and lacked metrics-based accountability. 
•	Ensured new platform was adopted by the entire franchise community through a series of webinars, calls, emails and a presentation at the annual franchise conference. 
•	Improved availability and reliability of proprietary platform to 99.999999% within 6 months by implementing processes and procedures for how to test and deploy releases, and supported procedures with a CI/CD pipeline that would automate the testing and deployment process.

•	Led technology teams to exceed KPIs and outcomes, including System Administrators, DevOps Engineers and Business Intelligence Analysts, managing a budget of ~$2.5M.
•	Spearheaded efforts to identify potential waste in company processes across every department and mark areas that would benefit from IT automation and process improvement; implemented enhancements which resulted in ability to redirect 500 employee hours spent monthly to other projects.
•	Defined and executed strategic objectives and supported all initiatives with the proper application of technology, including guiding the implementation of a business intelligence platform that provides data updates to managers on a daily basis.
•	Maintained responsibility for all backup and recovery processes and risk management and crafted the company’s business continuity plan, protecting the PII of ~250,000 borrowers and prospective borrowers.
•	Oversaw the migration of Loan Origination Software, which reduced loan processing time from ~60 days to less than 30 days while reducing annual labor cost by ~12%.
•	Created, managed and maintained an advanced hybrid onsite and cloud infrastructure spanning 4 distinct geographic regions: Northern Virginia, Oregon, Northern California and Ohio.
•	Designed and implemented information systems that improve the consumer and partner experience.
•	Protected consumer data by maintaining secure systems and practices that exceeded the security requirements of the SSAE-16 SOC 2 Type II and other similar audit standards.
•	Determined long-term organization-wide information needs, systems development and hardware acquisition, and integration including mainframe, mini, macro, and client/server computing applications. 
•	Directed all IT operations to meet customer requirements while supporting the maintenance of existing infrastructures and applications. 
•	Oversaw the development and design of new applications.
